[9] (ran4_cr_chunks 38.141-2, sim=0.448)
[CR CR0372 for 38.141-2] Reason for change: As per RAN4 leadship’s guidance, big CR approach will be used to merge several draft CRs to minimize the MCC’s workload for implementation of the specification. This big CR merges the mutile endorsed draft CRs. The reason for change in each endorsed draft CR are copied below: R4-2115680 draftCR: UCI and PTRS overhead for channel bits calculation in PUSCH FRC The UCI and PT-RS overhead are not taken into account for the calculation of “Total number of bits per slot” and “Total symbols per slot” in the PUSCH FRCs, but they are rate matched during the data mapping. Summary of change: The summary of change in each each endorsed draft CR is copied below. R4-2115680 draftCR: UCI and PTRS overhead for channel bits calculation in PUSCH FRC Added one note
